sub_graphs.title: Electra P2P: Gossip Message Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules applied to gossip messages in the Electra fork, including beacon blocks, attestations, and blob sidecars

nodes.label: Gossip Message Received
nodes.description: A gossip message has been received from a peer on a subscribed topic

nodes.label: Validate KZG Commitment Count
nodes.description: Check that the number of KZG commitments in the beacon block does not exceed MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA

nodes.label: Validate Aggregate Committee Bits
nodes.description: For beacon_aggregate_and_proof: verify committee_bits has exactly 1 bit set and aggregate data index equals 0

nodes.label: Validate Single Attestation
nodes.description: For beacon_attestation subnets: verify attestation data index is 0 and attester is a member of the committee

nodes.label: Validate Blob Sidecar Limits
nodes.description: For blob_sidecar subnets: verify blob index and commitments against MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA

nodes.label: Message Accepted for Processing
nodes.description: The gossip message passed all validation checks and is accepted for further processing

nodes.label: Message Rejected
nodes.description: The gossip message failed validation and is discarded; peer may be penalized

external_entities.name: Peer Node
external_entities.description: Another consensus client sending gossip messages over the libp2p network

sub_graphs.title: Electra P2P: Request/Response Protocols
sub_graphs.description: Models the request/response protocols for beacon blocks and blob sidecars in the Electra fork

nodes.label: Request Received from Peer
nodes.description: An incoming request has been received on a req/resp protocol stream

nodes.label: Process BeaconBlocksByRange v2
nodes.description: Handle request for sequential beacon blocks; return fork-appropriate SignedBeaconBlock types including electra.SignedBeaconBlock for Electra slots

nodes.label: Process BeaconBlocksByRoot v2
nodes.description: Handle request for specific beacon blocks by root hash; return fork-appropriate types

nodes.label: Process BlobSidecarsByRange v1
nodes.description: Handle request for blob sidecars in a slot range; return up to MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA sidecars

nodes.label: Process BlobSidecarsByRoot v1
nodes.description: Handle request for specific blob sidecars by identifier; limit response to MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA

nodes.label: Response Sent to Peer
nodes.description: The response has been serialized and sent back to the requesting peer

nodes.label: Error Response Sent
nodes.description: An error response was sent due to invalid request parameters or missing data

external_entities.name: Requesting Peer
external_entities.description: A peer node making req/resp protocol requests for blocks or blob sidecars

sub_graphs.title: Electra P2P: SingleAttestation Propagation
sub_graphs.description: Models the new SingleAttestation format introduced in Electra for attestation subnet propagation

nodes.label: SingleAttestation Created by Validator
nodes.description: A validator has created a SingleAttestation object (replacing the previous Attestation format on subnets)

nodes.label: Publish to Attestation Subnet
nodes.description: Publish the SingleAttestation to the appropriate beacon_attestation_{subnet_id} topic

nodes.label: Validate Attester Committee Membership
nodes.description: Verify the attester index is a member of the committee for the given slot and committee index

nodes.label: Validate Data Index Is Zero
nodes.description: Ensure attestation.data.index == 0 as required by Electra format changes

nodes.label: Attestation Accepted and Propagated
nodes.description: The SingleAttestation has passed validation and is forwarded to other peers

edges.label: All checks passed, forward to peers

external_entities.name: Attesting Validator
external_entities.description: A validator creating and publishing SingleAttestation messages

ambiguities.text: MAX_REQUEST_BLOB_SIDECARS_ELECTRA is defined as MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB * MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK_ELECTRA but it is unclear if MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB retains its Deneb value or could be redefined.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS_DENEB is a fixed constant from the Deneb specification and is not modified by Electra. This needs cross-reference verification.

ambiguities.text: The specification states blob sidecars must include 'at least the first blob-carrying block's sidecars if available' but does not define behavior when partial data is available.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the responder must return all available sidecars for the first blob-carrying block or none, treating partial sidecar sets as unavailable.

implicit_assumptions.description: Peers are assumed to correctly implement fork version negotiation and will not send Deneb-format messages after the Electra fork epoch.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Nodes could accept incorrectly formatted messages if they don't strictly validate fork version, leading to consensus divergence.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BLOB_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT_ELECTRA of 9 subnets provides sufficient distribution capacity for the increased blob count.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Subnet congestion could cause blob propagation delays, affecting data availability and block validity.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot flood attestation subnets with valid-looking SingleAttestation messages faster than honest nodes can validate committee membership.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Denial of service on attestation propagation, potentially delaying finality.
